messages:
maria.g: Heads up — deploy of idp-normalizer v2.1 just went out and we're seeing a surge of SAML JIT failures for service accounts. Some bots can't perform billing tasks.

sam.k: Any errors in the logs?

maria.g: Yeah, sample from the auth service: `WARN SAMLAssertionProcessor - missing required attribute 'employeeNumber' for user=svc-reporter@acme`

maria.g: When the attribute is absent the mapping falls back to default role set, which for some legacy tenants ends up as `viewer` (no billing write).

kevin.t: That normalizer PR flattened attributes and also trimmed leading zeros. I flagged a breaking test but it got merged for perf. PR #423

jessica.r: Oof. Do we have automated test coverage for service accounts / system principals?

maria.g: Not comprehensive. Most CI tests cover human user flows, not service account JIT edge cases.

idp-bot: Alert: 87 JIT provisioning failures in last 5m for tenant acme-corp. Error signature: MISSING_ATTR_employeeNumber

oncall: Escalating to SEV-2. Oncall will coordinate rollback if needed.

kevin.t: Short term: revert normalizer change (revert PR #423) and patch mapping to treat missing employeeNumber as non-fatal for service accounts. Long term: add explicit attribute whitelist and tests.

sam.k: Can we patch mapping to prefer `servicePrincipal` claim first? We already have `servicePrincipal=true` in some SAML assertions. That would avoid relying on employeeNumber.

maria.g: Good idea. I can push a hotfix to the mapping service: if `servicePrincipal`==true then skip employeeNumber enforcement.

jessica.r: Also add a guardrail in the console UI to surface when required attributes are being enforced by tenant config — so ops can catch this before merge.

kevin.t: I'll open a rollback PR now and add the test changes to the hotfix branch.

maria.g: Pushing hotfix to canary now. Will monitor idp-bot.

idp-bot: Update: JIT failures down to 6 in the last 5m after hotfix deploy.

oncall: Continue monitoring. Postmortem and action items: 1) revert PR #423 (if not already), 2) hotfix mapping to prefer servicePrincipal, 3) add CI tests for svc accounts and attribute-presence matrix, 4) update rollout checklist to include idp attribute contract, 5) run audit of tenant configs that rely on employeeNumber.

sam.k: I'll take the CI tests item. kevin.t take rollback, maria.g own hotfix and monitoring, jessica.r own console guardrail.

maria.g: Noted. Filing tracking ticket SEC-1029 and adding stakeholders.

jessica.r: Thanks all — glad we caught this quickly. :thumbsup:

kevin.t: We should also add a KMS/audit note: all JIT denials should write a structured audit entry with the assertion digest so we can correlate future incidents. I'll add that to the postmortem.

maria.g: Agreed.

oncall: Closing SEV-2 to SEV-3 while monitoring. Update channel when fully resolved.
